SHIPPED: Whisnap MVP launched Feb 10 (Week 1 ✅). Week 2: ~10 users from ~100 visitors ❌. Week 3: €0 revenue ❌.
DEMO DAY: Feb 26, 2026. 3-minute pitch, 7 slides. Honest about traction (10 users, €0). Key slide: 'In 3 weeks, I learned what takes most founders 3 months. Only truly free local mode.' Strategy was getting meetings, not investment.
OUTCOME: No wins, no investor interest at the event itself.
INVESTOR FOLLOW-UP: MOC reached out post-demo — 'As MOC we're investing early anywhere up to EUR 3m.' Ned is low on motivation for Whisnap but a call costs nothing. Reply strategy: warm, short, get to a call without committing. On call: pitch is YOU (solo guy, marketer background, built full-stack from zero), not the product metrics.
CURRENT STATE: Bored of Whisnap. Pivoting to build-in-public / YouTube content first. App as prop for content, not vice versa. Job offer €3k/month with March 9 deadline lingering.
